title: Worldseed v45: Life A Living, Breathing Ecosystem Update
author: niklasdaking
selftext:
# ✦ WORLDSEED UPDATE ✦

Working with Claude is like magic, I moved my project into GitHub recently and we have setup a great way to test, QA, and change things so quickly now, I just want to share a quick video shot by Claude himself of the massive update we just now released to [Itch.io](http://Itch.io)

# LIFE

* A world of its own

>The wilderness is no longer just scenery.  
**The world is alive, even when you're not watching.**

**Worldseed** a retro-inspired open-world fantasy adventure made with Claude Opus 5.5 (and me) just got a massive update!

With **v45: Life**, we completely overhauled how the world feels. Previously, wildlife came and went like weather. Now? The planet is genuinely alive.

*Here's a glimpse of what's new...*

# 01 / THE CIRCLE OF LIFE

|Rotting Carcasses & Scavengers Leave a kill behind and the world takes care of the rest. Flies arrive first, followed by ants. The meat darkens, sinks, and eventually leaves nothing but bones. Crows and vultures circle overhead and descend to feed and whatever they eat, you miss out on.|
|:-|


# 02 / THE HUNTERS

|Predator Packs & Hunting Wolves, big cats, and hyenas now actively chase down herds. Watch from a distance and they'll leave you alone — but get too close to their kill, and they'll defend it. High above, hawks sometimes dive for hares and small birds in the grass.|
|:-|


# 03 / FEATHER & FANG

|Small Game & Fletched Arrows Ducks paddle across still water, geese graze along the banks, grouse burst out of the grass, and rabbits dart back into their warrens. Hunt birds, collect their feathers, and craft proper fletched arrows that fly faster and flatter.|
|:-|


# 04 / CONSEQUENCES

|The Land Remembers Hunt an area too hard and its wildlife will grow scarce for days. Meanwhile, your own livestock can breed: keep compatible animals together, make sure their troughs stay full, and you may find some new arrivals in your pens.|
|:-|


# 05 / YOUR FIELD NOTES

|The Creature Journal Discover creatures up close and record them in your Journal. Learn where you've encountered them, keep track of your hunting record, and find out what resources each creature provides — from the largest predators right down to the ants.|
|:-|


# ⚠ A NOTE BEFORE YOU BEGIN

|**v45 requires a fresh world!** Terrain and world generation have changed, so older saves can't carry over. Start a new game to experience the update.|
|:-|


# YOUR WORLD AWAITS

Play right in your browser, or take Worldseed with you as a single HTML file that runs on its own.

[**🌿 PLAY WORLDSEED**](https://generic-king.itch.io/worldseed)

*✦ A vast world. Countless paths. One adventure to call your own. ✦*

**WORLDSEED**
